title: Refactor discount APIs across three modules
prompt: Refactor all three production modules to the new percentage-discount contract and update every production call site. In pricing.py replace apply_discount(amount, discount_amount) with discounted_total(subtotal, discount_rate), where the rate is between 0 and 1 inclusive, an invalid rate raises ValueError, and the final result is rounded to two decimals. In invoice.py replace total_after_discount(line_prices, discount_amount) with invoice_total(line_prices, discount_rate). In report.py replace render_summary with render_invoice and return exactly `Invoice total: $N.NN`. Remove the old public names rather than keeping compatibility aliases. Do not edit the tests. Run python3 -m unittest to verify the refactor.
